overview.description: The Tradr 2X Short SpaceX Daily ETF (SPCG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund provides inverse (-2x) exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Space Exploration Technologies Corporation (NASDAQ: SPCX) stock. SPCG was launched on Jun 12, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
